jobs.name: Pick an order: Rack B to packing
jobs.description: Collect an item beside Rack B, leave the storage aisle and bring it to the packing station.

jobs.name: Put away stock: receiving to Rack A
jobs.description: Move incoming stock from the receiving bay to the access point beside Rack A.

jobs.name: Put away stock: receiving to Rack C
jobs.description: Carry incoming stock across the main aisle to the access point beside Rack C.

jobs.name: Pick an order: Rack A to packing
jobs.description: Collect an item beside Rack A and deliver it to the packing station.

jobs.name: Pick an order: Rack C to packing
jobs.description: Collect an item beside Rack C and deliver it to the packing station.

jobs.name: Ship a parcel: packing to dispatch
jobs.description: Move a packed parcel from the packing station to the dispatch bay.

jobs.name: Return to the charging dock
jobs.description: After dispatch, return through the perimeter aisle to the charging dock.

scope: Warehouse demonstration development split; named delivery jobs are excluded from training starts. No independent final assessment.
